summary: Iteration 7 end-to-end: wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter7.py (20 tests, 20/20 pass in ~50s) covering (1) catalogues (21 workbooks, all download as valid xlsx, every block's topic columns are consistent across sheets per paper number, all non-empty topic cells in gr12-maths + gr12-physical-sciences match the Q-ref regex or '-'); (2) locate() returns found=False with 'greyed out' reason for Gr12 Maths National Nov 2028 P1 and found=True for Gr12 Maths IEB Nov 2019 P1; (3) POST /api/catalogues/refresh-topics returns {updated,cleared} and every QP question topic in done sets is null or in its catalogue topics after; (4) manual erase API: GET returns manual+pages, POST rejects boxes with wrong length / out-of-range / non-overlapping (400), valid overlapping manual box applies -> erase_status='applied', erase_manual contains the box, storage_path changes; boxes=[],manual=[] -> erase_status='rejected' and erase_manual=[]; (5) Drive: GET /api/drive/status (connected=false, root includes DRIVE_ROOT_PATH), GET /api/drive/connect (authorization_url -> accounts.google.com with access_type=offline, redirect_uri .../api/drive/callback), POST /api/drive/sets/{id}/send -> 400 'Connect Google Drive first', GET /api/drive/callback?state=bogus&code=x -> 307 to /?drive=error, all /api/drive/* except /callback require auth (401 without); (6) drive.plan_uploads() on the IEB PS set yields PDFs under Paper_2/Memo_Paper_2/Addendum/Errata (replace=False), per-question PNGs under Questions/Paper_2/Question_{main}/{Question|Memo|Addendum|Errata} (replace=True) plus empty Hints/Video folders, with 'Grade 12/Physical Sciences/Nov/IEB' in the path; (7) ai.cut_bands unit: segment 100-400 with bands (200,250)+(380,450) -> two pieces 100-200 and 250-380, both label '1.1', marks only on first. Regression: full suite 65 passed / 4 failed / 1 skipped — the 4 failures are the same seed-drift carry-over documented in iter 6 (test_set_detail_structure, test_expected_links, test_set_zip_filenames_width in test_papercut_api.py all assume 7 QP questions in Mathematics_Gr12_2024_Nov_National_P1 but a previous destructive merge/delete test has left only 1 QP question in the seeded Mongo doc — the destructive test now auto-skips because <3 questions). The one iter7 failure I hit on the first full-suite run (test_drive_endpoints_require_auth) was caused by test_papercut_api.py's module-level requests.get monkey-patch leaking auth headers across test modules; fixed by using a requests.Session() instead. Playwright UI: cookie-authed workspace loads, header shows drive-connect-button ('Connect Drive'); opened PhysicalSciences_Gr12_2023_Nov_IEB_P2 set — drive-set-panel + drive-send-button visible; clicking drive-send-button raises toast 'Connect Google Drive first'. Opened Q1.1 lightbox: tabs 'Image / Memo / Erase / Adjust crop' are always present (Erase tab visible with no AI proposals). On Erase tab: erase-review visible, erase-status='applied', erase-apply-button present, erase-canvas-0 present; a mouse drag drew a new amber manual box (erase-manual-count showed '2 drawn by you'), the erase-manual-remove-* button removes it. On Memo tab: 4 linked-memo-* elements each with -image / -erase / -adjust mode buttons (LinkedEditor confirmed). 'Refresh paper topics' button visible in the Catalogues panel. Did NOT run the destructive sync tests on a fresh uploaded set (QP+memo end-to-end Gemini processing is 1-3 min per doc, and I avoided mutating the only remaining healthy done set per the problem statement's explicit warning).

minor.issue: test_merge_next_and_delete_question still permanently mutates the seeded Mathematics_Gr12_2024_Nov_National_P1 set; it now auto-skips because questions<3 but the earlier three tests (test_set_detail_structure, test_expected_links, test_set_zip_filenames_width) still assert 7 QP questions and fail. Fix: either re-seed the Math set from the snapshots in /app/memory/catalogues_backup_* / sample PDFs, or convert the merge/delete test to use its own throwaway uploaded set. Not iteration 7 related.

Minor: errors are logged but the state doc is deleted BEFORE the exchange, so a user whose first redirect fails cannot retry the SAME code without reinitiating connect. Acceptable because Google won't re-issue the code anyway, but the UX could pre-check and keep state until successful exchange.

action_items: (Pre-existing from iter 5) Re-seed Mathematics_Gr12_2024_Nov_National_P1 OR make test_merge_next_and_delete_question self-reverting so the three failing papercut tests (test_set_detail_structure, test_expected_links, test_set_zip_filenames_width) pass. All three failures are 'assert 7 == 1' style — the data is damaged, not the code.

(Nice-to-have) In test_papercut_api.py the module-level monkey-patch of requests.get/post leaks into any pytest-xdist worker that loads both modules; consider using a pytest fixture (autouse) or a Session per-test instead so other test modules can exercise unauth paths without workarounds.
critical_code_review_comments: drive.py plan_uploads: addenda/errata linked by exact-label dedupe is enforced via (j, lq) not in out in routes.linked_targets but plan_uploads does not dedupe linked image uploads; if a QP question links two addendum rows with the same label the second write hits put() with replace=True and silently overwrites. In practice unlikely but worth a dedupe by (storage) key.

drive.py _flow uses PKCE (code_challenge in authorization_url) which is good, but the OAuth state doc stores only {_id, user_email, created_at} — no expiry. A stale state can accumulate forever. Add TTL index or expires_at. Low priority.

routes.py valid_manual: good hard validation (len==5, 0<=y0<y1<=1000, overlap with crop). Duplicates in the submitted list are deduped. However there is no limit on the number of manual boxes per question — a client could POST thousands and each creates a pymupdf redaction. Consider cap (e.g. 100).

catalogue.py build_workbook writes topic_cells by column; when a stored topic no longer exists in the current catalogue (post refresh-topics clear), it is silently dropped — tests confirm. Good. But a down-grade of a topic to an older-named column without rename mapping would silently vanish — RENAMES in syllabus.py currently only maps old->new, not new->old. Document that renames are append-only.

ai.cut_bands: when a band exactly abuts the segment start (band.y0 <= seg.y0), the first piece becomes zero-width and is correctly filtered by `q[1]-q[0] > 5`. OK. But the 'marks only on first' logic uses enumerate(pieces) — if the first piece gets filtered out mid-pass this isn't the case. In practice the current impl filters inside the inner comprehension so i=0 is still the surviving first piece. Correct for the current pass order.

jobs.py rebuild_question erase_manual: `q.erase_manual = [b for b in (erase_manual or []) if b in applied]` — this quietly drops manual boxes that were sent but somehow didn't make it into applied. Since in apply_erase() applied = AI-chosen + manual, this is only a problem if valid_manual throws (which raises 400 before we get here). Correct.

drive.py send_set: no check that the set has 0 pending erases — if a user clicks Send to Drive before approving erases they will upload the un-erased crops. The auto_send path respects it (jobs.refresh_set) but the manual button doesn't. Add `if any(q.erase_status == 'pending' for ...): raise 400 'Approve erases first'` to be safe.
